What is an AI brand advertisement?

An AI brand advertisement uses generated visuals within a directed production process: brief, script, shot planning, editing and finishing. The film should communicate one clear product or brand message to a defined audience.

What affects the quote?

Film length, scene complexity, product accuracy, character continuity, voice, music, revisions and delivery versions determine the scope. Send approved product references, campaign objective, required ratios and deadline for a project-specific discussion.
